requirements.text: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent professional experience)
Minimum experience: candidates must have at least 3 years of hands-on experience building full-stack applications.
Work authorization: candidates must be authorized to work in the United States on a permanent basis, without current or future need for employer visa sponsorship.
On-site work: this position requires on-site presence five days a week in our New York City office. Remote work options are not available.
Solid understanding of software development methodologies and best practices
Experience designing and consuming REST APIs
Experience working with relational databases and SQL
Comfort picking up scripting or automation work (e.g., Python) as part of day-to-day development
Strong problem-solving skills and meticulous attention to detail
Ability to work autonomously or within a small, collaborative team
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
A passion for learning new technologies and continuously improving your technical skills
: React, Next.js, TypeScript, C# / .NET, REST API development, Microsoft SQL Server and SQL, Python, Docker, Git and modern development workflows
